data.name: CheckBoxRestrictColorWavelength.ToolTip
data.value: Samples with very low signal at low wavelengths may have high noise in the measured color. If the spectrum is known to be slowly varying at low wavelengths, then checking this box and setting and appropriate lower limit may improve color measurement reproducibility without significantly degrading accuracy.

data.name: ChkAlwaysShowXYZ.ToolTip
data.value: If Color Space other than None is selected, then also compute and display CIE-XYZ results

data.value: Show Optics Config./ Active Spec. Status

data.name: LabelNumSpectra.Text
data.value: Maximum number of spectra to display in the graph (1-10):

data.name: TBNColorWavelengthLowerLimit.ToolTip
data.value: For purposes of color measurement, the spectrum at wavelengths less than this value is assumed to be constant at whatever value it has at this wavelength.

data.name: CheckBoxFixLuminance.ToolTip
data.value: Regardless of measured luminance, when painting color swatch box or boxes on screen use luminance value entered at right instead. This makes it easier to see the color when measured luminance is low. If luminance is less than 10%, then paint swatch with luminance scaled by value at right

data.name: CheckBoxFixLuminance.Text
data.value: Fix luminance of color swatch at ({0}-100):

data.name: CheckBoxDisplayTransmittanceColor.ToolTip
data.value: If active spectrum has both reflectance and transmittance spectra, then decision to display the color of the transmittance spectrum is controlled by this check box.

data.name: TBNColorWavelengthUpperLimit.ToolTip
data.value: For purposes of color measurement, the spectrum at wavelengths greater than this value is assumed to be constant at whatever value it has at this wavelength.
